arrive.text: The past. The town where your grandparents met.

see_gf.text: That's your grandfather. Young, and in a hurry.

see_gm.text: At the station, a woman is waiting. Your grandmother.

ask.text: If they never meet, you are never born. And then who came back to stop him?

gate_fail.text: A gust of wind. The gate swings open again.

sign_fail.text: He doesn't even look at the sign. He knows the way.

block_fail.text: He steps around you, and apologises.

tell_fail.text: He laughs. What a strange thing to say. And he walks on.

met.text: They meet, just as they always did.

tried_1.text: Every time you tried, something ordinary got in the way. Nothing magic.

tried_2.text: It had already happened. Unless, somewhere else, it didn't.

watched_1.text: You came all this way, and changed nothing.

watched_2.text: Maybe that's the only story that works.

paper.text: The date on the paper is long before you were born. The headline is about the weather.

try.text: Is it possible to stop him? See if you can.

gun_fail.text: The pistol jams. It's old, and it jams.

in_a_sense.text: You could have stopped him, in a sense. You just didn't.

again.text: The clock turns back. He's at his door again.
